label: Text 1
transcript: Frida the fox sits at a cafe table that is too tall for her. The waiter is professional. He does not comment on the fox. "Good afternoon. What can I get you?" Frida considers. "A cup of tea, please. And a small piece of cake — preferably the kind with apple in it." Mia, at the next table, mouths thank you to the waiter for not laughing.
